caseName: Pure-Vac Dairy Products Corp. v. Mississippi ex rel. Patterson
caseNameFull: PURE-VAC DAIRY PRODUCTS CORP. v. MISSISSIPPI ex rel. PATTERSON, ATTORNEY GENERAL
